entities.name: RRC connection re-establishment
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the UE to re-establish the RRC connection after radio link failure or handover failure.

entities.name: RRCReestablishmentRequest
entities.description: Message sent by the UE to request re-establishment of the RRC connection.

entities.name: RRCReestablishment
entities.description: Message sent by the network to re-establish the RRC connection.

entities.name: RRCReestablishmentComplete
entities.description: Message sent by the UE to confirm successful re-establishment of the RRC connection.

entities.name: RRC-CONNECTED
entities.description: RRC state where the UE has an established RRC connection with the network.

entities.name: Radio link failure
entities.description: Condition that triggers the RRC connection re-establishment procedure when the UE detects radio link failure.

relations.description: The re-establishment procedure includes sending the RRCReestablishmentRequest message.
The re-establishment procedure includes receiving the RRCReestablishment message from the network.
The re-establishment procedure includes sending the RRCReestablishmentComplete message.
The re-establishment procedure is triggered by radio link failure condition.
Successful completion of the re-establishment procedure transitions the UE to RRC-CONNECTED state.
